'''Telti''' was a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].

==Characteristics==
It was the location of a major [[Droid/Legends|droid]] construction facility, which covered nearly the entire surface of the moon. The moon had no [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], and all the manufacturing facilities were located in [[Domed city/Legends|domed structures]] connected via [[Docking tube/Legends|air-tight tunnels]] and overland corridors. It was guarded by a wide range of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and [[Guard droid/Legends|guard droids]].<ref name="SGtD" />

==History==
Prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Telti was the site of one of the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] factories which produced [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]]. This factory and others across the galaxy were shut down prior to the outbreak of war, leading to 12.5 million employees being laid off. While business reasons were cited, in reality, the Techno Union had joined forces with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]], and had moved production lines to worlds in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], far from the prying eyes of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] inspectors.

After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] the moon joined the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], but fell under the control of [[Brakiss]], a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] underling of [[Kueller]]. On Kueller's orders Brakiss produced droids on Telti equipped with bombs. These droids were used to decimate [[Almania]], [[Pydyr]], [[Auyemesh]], and [[Smuggler's Run/Legends|Smuggler's Run]], as well as bomb the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]].

The droid threat was eventually stopped when [[Cole Fardreamer]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] travelled to the planet after discovering bombs planted inside upgraded [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-Wing]] starfighters. After Cole was captured and sent away to be tortured, R2-D2 reprogrammed a number of old astromech droids stored on the planet. With their help, R2-D2 managed to overpower the [[Warden 10-24 security droid|Red Terror]], modified gladiator droids set to the guard the manufacturing facility, and deactivate the explosives with Brakiss' remote. Brakiss was then driven into his shuttle and off of the planet by the remaining astromech units, escaping.

[[EV-9D9/Legends|EV-9D9]] and [[EV-9D9.2]] were assembled on Telti.
